Thanks again for taking the demo today  appreciated the thoughtful questions, John and Samantha. Quick recap and a proposed, lightweight POC plan so we can get to hands-on validation next week.

Demo highlights
- Latency: P95 under 180ms on our dedicated profile for the prompt shapes you showed.
- Cost controls: batching + cache settings that we can tune to match your throughput targets.
- Security: private VPC & KMS support; SOC2 artifacts available (see attached/drive link).

Proposed POC (3-week, goal: validation of performance and quality on your key flows)
1) Week 0 (kickoff, 2-3 business days): environment setup (VPC peering / API keys / sample dataset ingest). Owner: Redwood (Camila / Dylan) + FinServ infra (Samantha).
2) Week 1 (functional tests): run canonical prompts and API load tests, confirm integration flows. Owner: FinServ product (John) + Redwood SE (Dylan).
3) Week 2 (stress & tuning): throughput/latency tuning, cost profiling, iterate on batching/quantization recommendations. Owner: Redwood SE.
4) Week 3 (evaluation & handoff): run success criteria tests, review results, decide go/no-go. Owner: Joint.

Success criteria (examples - we can refine)
- Latency: P95 <= 200ms for 4k-context demo prompts under your target concurrency.
- Accuracy/Quality: pass rate >= 90% on the provided eval set (we'll use the spreadsheet attached).
- Cost: projected cost per 1k tokens within the budget you indicated (we'll show actual vs baseline).

Attachments: FinServ_POC_eval_plan.xlsx (evaluation prompts, measurement scripts), Demo-recording.mp4. Drive copy: https://drive.google.com/finserv-poc-eval-plan

Proposed kickoff slots: Thu Aug 28 (10-11am PT) or Mon Aug 31 (9-11am PT). Please confirm which works and who from your side will own the product & infra tasks. Once confirmed, Dylan will schedule the SE technical kickoff and I'll share the initial onboarding checklist.

Thanks - excited to get started.

-
